Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Scott,
I have a minion armed with 2 Flame Throwers and a Ghoul Retainer and I
get into combat with a Gargoyle and another Gargoyle with Winged
Second.

If I am at long range, can I then choose to shoot the Winged Second
with my minions Flame Thrower and the non-winged Second with the Ghoul
Retainer Flame Thrower.

Do I send them both to torpor?

Can I play two amaranths to diablerize them both?

Relavent Texts:

Winged Second
Type: Reaction
Requires: Flight
[FLIGHT] Only usable when another minion you control enters combat with
a minion without flight. Tap this minion. In that combat, this minion
may make a hand or melee weapon strike (with or without a strike card)
on the opposing minion during normal strike resolution (as if at close
range). Dodge will avoid this strike, and damage prevention effects can
treat this as a strike from an opposing minion. This minion may be the
target of effects that inflict damage or steal blood as a retainer
could be.

Amaranth
Type: Combat
Only usable by a vampire who can commit diablerie. Only usable when the
opposing vampire should go to torpor. Diablerize the opposing vampire
instead. Not usable by a vampire going to torpor.

Ghoul Retainer
Type: Retainer
Cost: 2 pool
Ghoul with 2 life. 1 strength.
Each round of combat during strike resolution, the Ghoul Retainer
inflicts 1 damage or may use a weapon that is not being used by the
employing minion (or another retainer) during that round. This is not a
strike, although it does count as "using" the weapon.

Flamethrower
Type: Equipment
Cost: 4 pool
Weapon.
2R aggravated damage each strike.

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: Ron in San Diego
Messages.Body:
I'm guessing the part of Winged Second's text that says the Winged
Second can be targeted like a retainer. You can't play Amaranth when
you burn a retainer.
Or the part of Amaranth that says it is only usable when the opposing
vampire should go to torpor. The Winged Second is not the opposing
vampire.


The omission of any part that would allow it.

Amaranth allows you to diablerize the opposing vampire (when
the opposing vampire should go to torpor).

The Winged Second is not an opposing vampire.
